email.body1:
Gena, saw Celigo was named the only Gartner Peer Insights Customers' Choice for iPaaS and is pushing AI agents across the enterprise stack.

Momentum like that usually opens more in-market accounts than the team can cover before reps reach them all, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Celigo off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Gena, quick follow-up for Celigo.

With the Customers' Choice recognition and AI agents expanding the story, pipeline targets usually climb faster than ramp can keep up. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Celigo needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Gena, last bit of proof for Celigo.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Celigo's reply rate likely compares to peers. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
